clues: Disruptions to its systems led regional arbitration courts to postpone hearings after losing access to their legal databases.
Bot message volume across thousands of inauthentic social accounts plunged over 83 percent after an attack on its primary server campus.
Outages across its network affected at least eight nations, prompting Kazakhstan's digital ministry to help restore local services.
A drone strike disabled part of its operating infrastructure in Kaluga, while an attack in Vladimir halted all local operations.
A shutdown at its Ryazan campus took two of its three deep-learning supercomputers offline.
Drone strikes disrupted its search, taxi dispatch, and shopping services alongside its voice assistant Alisa.
